name: Tale of Unsettled Mists
status: draft; every number is a placeholder for playtesting
overview:
I welcome you to Havens Rest, our quint little port town. 
Well it used to be quint however I sadly have to say that recently that which goes bump in the night has become less of a myth and more of reality.
The mists roll in at night and as I watch out my window, screams can be heard on the salty winds from the seas. Rattles of dying breathes echo with hollow sounds in the dark corners of alleys.

steps.outro: Mark how many buildings are set on fire

steps.notes: For each buildings Fire marked down on the campaign log, set a district on fire. If all buildings would be set on fire instead don't set the well on fire. If the well wouldnt be set on fire because of this, add 3{perPlayer}{omen}
